lines.text: Moses and Aaron warn Pharaoh that the LORD will bring locusts into Egypt tomorrow if he refuses to let the people go.
Pharaoh's officials urge him to let the people go, but he says only the priests may go and worship.
The LORD sends a south wind, and by morning it has brought locusts that cover the land and eat everything green.
Pharaoh confesses his sin, and after Moses appeals to the LORD, a strong west wind blows the locusts into the Red Sea.
Total darkness covers Egypt for three days, yet all the Israelites have light in their dwellings.
